mission_06: Use np.linalg.matrix_rank() to find the rank of the matrix.
QR decomposition with np.linalg.qr() gives orthogonal Q and upper-triangular R.
Use np.linalg.lstsq() to solve the least-squares problem.
The residual is b - projection, which should be orthogonal to the column space.
The number of basis vectors equals the rank.
